what.text: The company operates in the manufacturing and marketing of a wide range of products, primarily in the adhesives and sealants sector. It serves both consumer and business markets with a diverse portfolio of products.

verdict.headline: Pidilite Industries shows strong revenue growth but faces margin pressure.

narrative_vs_numbers.text: Management's narrative of maintaining margins is partly supported by the numbers. While they stayed within the promised margin range, the operating margin dropped significantly year-on-year.

bull.text: Pidilite Industries achieved a significant annual revenue increase from ₹12,383 Cr in FY24 to ₹14,601 Cr in FY26.
The company has a strong cash conversion rate, with cumulative cash from operations at 118% of cumulative net profit over FY22–FY26.
Pidilite Industries reduced its borrowings from ₹454 Cr in FY25 to ₹417 Cr in FY26, and further to ₹351 Cr by Sep 2026.

bear.text: The operating margin for Sep 2026 was at the lower end of the expected range, dropping 4 percentage points from Sep 2025.
The stock P/E ratio is high at 60.3, which may indicate overvaluation.
The dividend yield is relatively low at 0.73%, which might not be attractive to income-focused investors.
